name: edu-workspace
description: 教材/教辅 PDF 后台扫描导入、REST API 管理、前端阅读批注与错题裁剪归类系统

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:server && npm run build:client:prod
scripts.build:client: VITE_APP_ENV=${VITE_APP_ENV:-TEST} VITE_APP_COMMIT=${VITE_APP_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)} npm run build --workspace=client && printf '%s' "${VITE_APP_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)}" > client/dist/build-commit.txt
scripts.build:client:prod: VITE_APP_ENV=PROD VITE_APP_COMMIT=${VITE_APP_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)} npm run build --workspace=client && printf '%s' "${VITE_APP_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)}" > client/dist/build-commit.txt
